items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I said, 'Well, all you can do is contact him.' ... And I helped him get in touch with him, and Oliver agreed to come and do it

ctx.x: And so they thought this was a good idea, but wanted to know did I think he would come. I said, 'Well, all you can do is contact him.'
And I helped him get in touch with him, and Oliver agreed to come and do it, and once he came, they liked his work.
